# togglr

An R client for the [Toggl Track](https://toggl.com/) API: start and stop
timers from R or RStudio, read and write time entries, projects and clients,
and download reports.

Reads never return silently truncated or empty results: HTTP errors are
raised, the hourly quota and rate limits of the API are respected, and
paginated reports are checked for completeness.

Documentation site: https://thinkr-open.github.io/togglr/

## Installation

togglr is installed from GitHub (the version on CRAN is outdated):

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ThinkR-open/togglr")
```

## Set your Toggl API token

Your token is at the bottom of your Toggl profile page:

```{r}
togglr::open_toggl_website_profile()
```

Store it once in your keyring:

```{r}
library(togglr)
set_toggl_api_token("your_token_api")
```

Every function also accepts an `api_token` argument, and a `workspace_id`
(the default workspace of your account otherwise, see `get_workspaces()`).

## Track your time

```{r}
toggl_start()   # a new entry, in a project named after your RStudio project
toggl_start(client = "my client", description = "what I'm doing",
            project_name = "my project", tags = c("dev", "R"))
toggl_stop()

get_current_duration()             # the running entry
get_current_project_task_detail()  # the tasks of the current project
```

RStudio addins 'start toggl' and 'stop toggl' are provided: bind them to
keyboard shortcuts.

## Reports

Reports come from the Toggl Reports API v3.

```{r}
# every time entry of a period, one row per entry
get_detailled_report(since = "2026-01-01", until = "2026-03-31")
# only some users
get_detailled_report(since = "2026-01-01", until = "2026-03-31", user_ids = 123456)

get_summary_report(since = "2026-09-01", until = "2026-09-30")  # per user
get_weekly_report(since = "2026-09-07", until = "2026-09-13")   # per project and day
get_dashboard(since = "2026-09-01", until = "2026-09-30")       # per project
```

`get_time_entries()` reads your own entries of the last 3 months (a limit of
the API); for older periods, use `get_detailled_report(user_ids = )`.

## Long extractions, several processes

A few options, documented in `?togglr`, tune the requests: for example
`options(togglr.min_interval = 16)` spreads a long extraction to spare the
hourly quota of the API, and `options(togglr.state_file = "...")` shares the
pacing and the known quota between R processes (callr, future, targets
workers).
